releases.name: Scroll Reverser 2.0
releases.body: Scroll Reverser 2.0 aims to solve common pain points of the 1.x versions and be even simpler to use. The app remains free and open source. _After upgrading from 1.x, please check your individual devices in Settings › Scrolling._ What's new in 2.0: - **A setting for each device.** Each individual trackpad, mouse or other input device now has its own scroll direction setting. Devices appear in Settings › Scrolling the first time you use them. - **Direction is set as "natural" or "classic".** Specify the outcome you want, instead how to get there. Trackpads default to natural, mice default to classic. - **More reliable and more efficient.** Scroll Reverser no longer detects trackpad usage using a gesture event tap. Instead, it reads device information directly. Instability of the gesture tap was was a frequent source of unreliability in previous versions. - **Better support for remote input devices.** Devices connected via Universal Control are recognised correctly, and a new "unchanged" option acts as a passthrough for situations like Screen Sharing. - **Only needs Accessibility permission.** Input Monitoring permission is no longer required. Fixed: - Fixed bug where Scroll reverser could suddenly stop working and need to be relaunched. - Fixed the menu bar icon appearing blurry on displays with a different resolution from the main display. - Fixed long lines in the debug console wrapping incorrectly. Added/Changed: - "Preferences" is now called "Settings", to match macOS. - Updated Sparkle (auto-update framework) to version 2.10.0. - Added Persian localization.
